bull.t: Profitability, cash generation and low leverage
bull.b: The sharp earnings recovery is supported by strong cash conversion rather than accounting profits alone, while minimal debt limits financial risk. This provides flexibility to fund technology, capacity and shareholder returns through the next several quarters.

Long-duration agreements with datacenter and Edge customers improve revenue visibility and deepen strategic relationships. NBMs exceeding half of bits in FY2027 and about two-thirds in FY2028 could make the mix less dependent on spot NAND demand.

A larger datacenter mix positions SanDisk for durable AI and infrastructure demand, while BiCS 8, BiCS 10 and high-bandwidth flash support performance, density and power advantages. These roadmaps can improve product relevance and mix over time.

bear.b: The recent step-change is not yet proven across a full cycle. Prior losses, volatile margins and negative free cash flow show that NAND pricing, demand and investment requirements can materially reverse earnings and cash generation.

Weakness in PCs and smartphones reduces demand for established removable and embedded storage products and can pressure mix. Although management expects recovery in 2027, the softer consumer base remains a meaningful diversification gap over the next several months.

Allocation beyond FY2027 may limit shipments despite strong demand, while higher dependence on major NBM customers increases execution and bargaining risk. Capacity constraints and concentration could restrict growth or amplify the impact of any customer change.
